name: rotary-disk-v1
simplifications: 2D cross-section model: the rotary disk's pocket is projected onto the singulation plane; justified because singulation is governed by transverse width vs passage clearance, and pocket depth enters only via pill thickness and mass.

Coulomb friction with a single per-pill coefficient; justified because disk-pocket wall contact during one 45-degree rotation is brief and coated/uncoated tablets are bracketed by the mu range 0.2-0.6.
Constant-velocity disk rotation with mean force over the stroke (E = F * d); justified because the 0.8 s stroke is slow enough that impact dynamics are negligible for sub-gram pills.
